mechanism: Moxifloxacin can prolong QT interval, and concurrent corticosteroids may increase risk of hypokalemia and cardiac arrhythmias; additionally, corticosteroids may mask signs of infection that fluoroquinolones are treating.
action: Monitor electrolytes (particularly potassium) and cardiac function; use with caution in patients with QT prolongation risk; ensure appropriate infection indication for moxifloxacin therapy.
